name: docs-preview-server-deployment
title: Package internal docs preview for SSH deployment
description: Package the verified local preview MVP for an internal Linux host with non-interactive publishing, health checks, systemd and Nginx templates, and idempotent install/update scripts that can be transferred over SSH.
scope: deploy/preview, scripts/publish-local-preview.mjs, scripts/check-local-preview.mjs, scripts/render-preview-server-config.mjs, scripts/local-preview-server.mjs, guides/preview-server-deployment.md, package.json
creator: wg
notes: Implemented portable one-shot publishing, serve-only runtime, persisted status, strict/degraded health checks, validated Linux systemd/Nginx/env rendering, dry-run-by-default install, and unprivileged update flow. Local server simulation verified release 1, release 2 without restart, strict health success, expected publish failure preserving release 2, strict degraded failure, and allow-degraded success. Local preview tests passed 5/5 and deployment rendering tests passed 2/2.
